negative_proof_interpretation: Native pause fails lifecycle and bounded evidence overflow; post-window old-generation HTTP409 remains fatal; aborted cohort ACK remains fatal. An ordinary delayed ACK was canceled by next-view cleanup and failed correctly. A separate harness disabled cancellation for only the delayed real request: the ACK issued before window end, settled after it, and its 4116.827709ms upper bound remained in the 27-sample cohort as p99/max. No market response was substituted.
